title: Does Analyst Coverage Affect Workplace Safety?
eligible_reason: Quasi-experiment from brokerage mergers and closures (Hong and Kacperczyk 2010; Kelly and Ljungqvist 2012). Implemented as a stacked, matched treated-control DiD: reg firm_tcr inter treat post <controls> i.year i.firm_id, cluster(event_id), where post is defined relative to each event for both treated firms and their matched controls, in a -3..+3 window excluding year 0. Stacked and event-specific post coding is an excluded design. Every column also includes about 18 time-varying firm controls. The OLS tables use continuous log analyst coverage. Regression datasets are not shipped.
design_notes: MSCode_MainTable_03-31-2021.do: Table 2 reghdfe firm_tcr ln_con_coverage_mean controls (continuous). Table 3 Panel B DiD on MS_firm_DiD_baseline.dta (742 obs), Panel C alternative matching. Table 4 establishment-level DiD with controls. Tables 6-7 triple interactions. Figure 3 is raw means by window. Output CSVs are shipped.
n_eligible_specs_note: Stacked matched-event DiD with time-varying controls in every column.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Multiple broker-event years, but the design is stacked by event_id. Data not shipped.

specs.treatment_var: inter = treat x post (with treat and post main effects)
specs.controls: ln_assets leverage1 ppe_assets sale_assets capex_assets mtob fcf_assets cash_assets commondvc_assets meetbeat roa roa_vol ln_emp_totalosha hours_per_emp_totalohsa firm_count_*
specs.sample_condition: matched treated-control firms, event window -3..+3 excluding 0
specs.notes: Excluded: stacked matched-event design; time-varying controls. Logged coefficient on inter: 1.075 (p = 0.075), N = 742.

data_access: licensed (Compustat, I/B/E/S, ISS, Thomson 13F via WRDS; Nelson's directory) plus public OSHA ODI
data_files_note: The README lists final .dta files (MS_firm_DiD_baseline.dta etc.), but none are included.
software_notes: Stata reghdfe, reg; SAS for sample construction.
